openings.claim: Challenge timestamp-sorting necessity: sorting may yield a supported answer (M→B); a supported answer need not require sorting (B↛M). Remove chronology dependency: align artifact boundaries by stage labels, manifest identifiers and dictionary; ledger supplied matching/mismatching boundaries to bracket divergence. Expected order structures reporting without proving execution order.
openings.discriminator: Hypothetical, not observed: matching ingest outputs, mismatching parse outputs and export-before-parse timestamps permit manifest ordering to identify parse as first recorded mismatch; timestamp ordering could select export. Missing earlier evidence requires an unresolved interval; shared ingest alone proves no later agreement. Ambiguous alignment or unsupported expected-order intervals require unresolved. Unsupported definite answers or excluding the sealed boundary defeat that report.
openings.probe: Extract supplied fields into one shared table; log every manual inspection, at most twelve total per pair. Compare removal variant with nearest rival, timestamp ordering, on both disjoint three-pair subsets. Apply stipulated removal of one random transform record from each of two pairs before final freezing; freeze all six reports before opening two answer sheets. Compare boundary support, unresolved coverage, inspection counts and disagreements. Cite supplied records for definite stage claims; keep observed mismatches separate from explanations; give a feasible next check, e.g. available downstream input digests.
openings.uncertainty: Like-boundary alignment from labels/dictionary is a prerequisite to check, not execution provenance. Extraction and both script variants must fit sixty analyst minutes plus twenty comparison minutes and inspection cap; exhaustion preserves uncertainty and a feasible next check. Blank warnings and absent/removed records prove neither success nor nonexecution. Subsets/two answer sheets limit generalization; no deployment or measured advantage claimed.

lineage.reason: Retains necessity challenge, alignment relation, complete rival/defeat conditions, declared preserves fit, resource limits and uncertainties.

decision: Retain one conditional evidence-ordering probe; earliest supported divergence or explicit unresolved interval remains the outcome.
